comment: Deliberate exception to MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2. The Cloud Router edge runtime is a separate edge process (CDN-style: it terminates public traffic and proxies upstream), so its upstream base URLs are genuinely cross-process and cannot be in-process calls. Every entry below names an edge upstream, not a backend module calling a sibling.

allow.reason: Separate edge process: the edge runtime proxies the portal surface upstream over HTTP by design (MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2.3 split-deployment exception).
Separate edge process: the edge runtime proxies upstream to the application gateway by design.
Separate edge process: the edge runtime proxies the backend-api surface upstream by design.
Separate edge process: the edge runtime proxies the app-api surface upstream by design.

Separate edge process (MODULE_SPEC.md §4.2.3 split-deployment exception), recorded file-scoped for the second detection mode: edge_server.rs is the proxy itself — it builds the outbound client and forwards /backend/v3/api and /app/v3/api to the upstreams parsed in edge_server_runtime_config.rs (four variables already allowlisted there). The edge runtime terminates public traffic in its own process, so it has no in-process sibling module to call.
